evidence: The catalog supports multiple profiles and optional features.
what: Choose the intended consumer, runtime and release scope, with Robotics-Prop 4.0.0 as the proposed first target.
how: Record the selected profile, resolved feature versions, runtime, operating modes and permitted claims before changing the derivative.
completion_evidence: A versioned contract identifies required and selected optional features and the matching runtime.
result: Robotics-Prop 4.0.0 is the static profile for the five-body study; a target dynamics runtime and functional interaction contract are not established.

evidence: The current 582.7 mm depth differs from the published 650 mm.
what: Resolve the configured device envelope, physical floor and front/rear datums without a global stretch that distorts known parts.
how: Measure a matching unit or reconcile reliable dimensional drawings against named model surfaces and document remaining uncertainty.
completion_evidence: Each agreed dimension has a datum, source, tolerance and recorded deviation.
result: The 582.7 vs 650 mm discrepancy is quantified and three hypothetical registrations are recorded; physical front/rear datum evidence is missing.

evidence: 22 objects in the diagnostic subset have non-manifold edges, including planar text and open tubes.
what: Audit actual solid/contact shapes for open seams, degenerate faces, wrong normals and unintended internal surfaces.
how: Inspect flagged evaluated meshes by function and repair or replace collision solids while retaining legitimate planar artwork.
completion_evidence: The runtime solids pass relevant topology checks and every retained open surface has an explicit purpose.
result: 42 collision meshes pass closed-topology checks. Of 272 visual meshes, 22 have indexed boundary edges and 220 triangles are exactly zero-area; 3,004 have cross-product magnitude below 2e-14 m². Intended artwork and seam repair remain to be assessed.

evidence: The source documents estimated pivots and possible display-to-rail intersections.
what: Resolve impossible intersections and verify assembly relationships before adding dynamics.
how: Check evaluated surfaces and clearances through each released pose and repair the fitted parts or constrain the permitted motion.
completion_evidence: No unexplained crossing remains in the declared operating range and contact/clearance evidence identifies tested surfaces.
result: Forty-nine modeled display poses show no crossings in selected Blender surfaces and no tested head-proxy/base-proxy overlaps outside the excluded mount pair; no continuous sweep, containment, full geometry or physical clearance is established.

evidence: The authoring scene includes studio, subject, obstacles, alternative parts and study helpers.
what: Define the exact equipment membership and configurations for export.
how: Build an explicit component manifest that includes the product parts and excludes staging, phantoms and unused variants from the runtime asset.
completion_evidence: Manifest and exported prim inventory agree and each configuration opens in its intended pose.
result: The 272-object visual selection, including three channel covers, is recorded in the visual export receipt.

evidence: Existing descriptive Blender names and parenting need stable USD identifiers and a physical datum.
what: Normalize the derivative hierarchy, transforms, floor pivot and stable part names.
how: Map native names to stable USD paths and verify world-space surfaces after applying the chosen transform and naming policy.
completion_evidence: Meters, Z-up, default prim, floor placement and component transforms survive a clean reopen and instancing.
result: Meters, Z-up, floor-centered origin and all 272 source-selected component bounds and material bindings are checked in the assembled stage; relocation is separately verified from the delivery archive.

evidence: Six diagnostic USD materials lack surface shaders despite bound materials.
what: Repair display backlight and UI divider, secondary, ink, white and cool grey blue materials in the USD derivative.
how: Replace unsupported node groups with exportable USD Preview Surface networks and verify their bound outputs in the target renderer.
completion_evidence: Every released visible mesh resolves a valid surface and all screen states remain legible in RTX.
result: All visible USD material bindings resolve; the saved display renders in Blender, while RTX and all UI states remain untested.

evidence: 36 diagnostic geometry objects lack UV layers and source finishes include procedural nodes.
what: Create UVs and portable texture inputs where the selected material representation requires them.
how: Unwrap the affected surfaces and bake procedural appearance into correctly tagged maps while preserving the editable Blender materials.
completion_evidence: Texture paths resolve in a relocated package and colorspace, map size, seams and texel density pass the chosen checks.
result: Procedural group shaders were translated into editable preview approximations; no texture bake or texel-density study was performed.

evidence: Glass, finish and display optical properties are unmeasured approximations.
what: Improve glass thickness and transmission, metal and white finish separation, labels and emissive screen appearance.
how: Compare matched neutral-light reference views and target-runtime renders while recording which material parameters are measured or estimated.
completion_evidence: Approved views include front, rear, close-up glass and display under multiple lights with a documented fidelity boundary.
result: Glass, display and finishes render in Blender; target RTX comparison and measured optical properties are unavailable.

evidence: The USD probe has no mass or rigid-body APIs; manufacturer net mass is 29.0 kg.
what: Author valid rigid bodies, mass, center of mass and inertia at the level needed by the release.
how: Use the verified assembly mass where applicable and distribute measured or explicitly estimated part properties with sensitivity checks.
completion_evidence: Mass totals reconcile and finite positive inertias and center-of-mass placement produce plausible declared behavior.
result: Five body masses sum to the published 29 kg and have finite positive inertia satisfying triangle inequalities; the distribution, inertia, center of mass and response are estimated.

evidence: The USD probe has no colliders.
what: Create efficient contact geometry for the platform, rail, feet, wheels, column and display.
how: Author simple or compound colliders that preserve the handrail opening and support surfaces independently of render detail.
completion_evidence: Collider overlays and contact scenarios show no filled openings, tunneling or unintended floor/support penetration.
result: 42 closed convex collision proxies represent separate links; the unpowered reconstructed Bullet drop settled on a floor while its display reached the tilt stop, with mounting arm omitted from the Bullet test.

evidence: Friction, restitution and real contact surfaces have not been measured.
what: Define physical materials for feet, tires, floor contact and any manipulation surfaces.
how: Measure representative behavior or declare provisional coefficients and test their effect over the intended contact scenarios.
completion_evidence: Contact-material provenance and parameter ranges accompany stable settling, traction and sliding results.
result: Placeholder friction and restitution are documented and three friction values were compared on an illustrative slope; material measurements are absent.

evidence: Parented display and transport controls are not portable physics joints.
what: Add display pivot and wheel joints only where supported by the chosen use case and device evidence.
how: Author connected bodies, joint frames, axes, limits and drives from measured or explicitly estimated mechanisms.
completion_evidence: Every released joint has a tested range, expected relative motion and no invented mechanical degree of freedom.
result: Two wheel revolutes and two display revolutes, estimated pivots and study limits are authored; reconstructed fixed-base Bullet probes exercise both directions, but the physical mechanism, stops, resistance and USD/PhysX motion remain unverified.

evidence: Connected parts and adjacent colliders may destabilize a multibody assembly.
what: Define intentional self-collision and contact filtering for connected links.
how: Test contact pairs and disable only structurally justified adjacent-link collisions while keeping useful external contacts active.
completion_evidence: Motion remains stable with external contacts enabled and exclusions are documented by pair and reason.
result: Connected-body pairs and one display/mount collider pair are filtered in USD, while mast/rail remain enabled; sampled proxy checks and a broader-exclusion Bullet test do not establish runtime contact behavior.

evidence: The display collection has 479 objects and extensive hidden state geometry.
what: Represent static artwork and dynamic UI with a compact runtime display surface while preserving native editability.
how: Bake static elements and generate display textures or a dedicated UI layer for dynamic values and touch targets.
completion_evidence: All supported states render without hidden-state leakage and touch regions stay aligned as the display moves.
result: The USD retains the saved display artwork and the display geometry moves with its study link; dynamic screen states, touch alignment and compact baked representation are not implemented.

evidence: The interactive controls depend on embedded Blender Python.
what: Separate the synthetic device state and calculations from Blender and implement a target-runtime adapter when interaction is required.
how: Define typed inputs, state transitions, deterministic timing and outputs with adapters for scene movement, display and synthetic audio.
completion_evidence: Repeatable scenarios cover tare, hold, units, scan, mock transfer failure/retry, reset and independent multiple instances.
result: A separate deterministic offline fictional subset exercises tare, hold, units, synthetic scans and mock failure/retry, including independent instances; no USD or Blender adapter or behavioral parity is claimed.

evidence: The ray fan and load study are explicitly approximate.
what: Establish an engineering validation scope before claiming physical weight or ultrasonic fidelity.
how: Acquire calibration observations and appropriate sensor/load parameters and compare model outputs against independent measurements across declared conditions.
completion_evidence: Error bounds and failure behavior are supported by a reproducible validation dataset rather than visual similarity.
result: Physical weighing and acoustic validation require instrument parameters and independent measurements.

evidence: No semantic APIs appear in the USD probe.
what: Add stable equipment and part semantics appropriate to the profile and downstream synthetic data tasks.
how: Author current USD semantic labels and verify a real relevant Wikidata class plus the instance and material label outputs.
completion_evidence: Masks remain correct across poses, occlusion and instances and taxonomy meaning is checked beyond Q-code syntax.
result: Equipment, part and estimated material labels are authored across links; target-runtime instance and material masks and taxonomy application remain untested.

evidence: A monolithic export mixes representations and behavior assumptions.
what: Organize geometry, appearance, physics and runtime-specific opinions into maintainable USD composition.
how: Keep shared visual content referenced by separate physics and runtime layers with explicit variants and relative dependencies.
completion_evidence: The asset can be relocated and instantiated without external local paths or conflicting instance state.
result: Five relative visual layers and a separate optional illustrative display-drive overlay are composed under an unpowered main stage; target-runtime-specific behavior is unverified.

evidence: The two footprint objects total 34,560 triangles and all UI states total substantial geometry.
what: Reduce geometry and draw calls where they do not improve silhouette, contact or task-visible detail.
how: Bake artwork, simplify threads and small hidden parts, and define optional detail variants against a measured target scene budget.
completion_evidence: Representative multi-asset scenes meet recorded frame-time, memory and visual-quality targets on the named hardware.
result: The render inventory measures 272 meshes, 81,964 points and 145,872 triangles; draw-call optimization, LOD, texture bake and target-scene performance remain open.

evidence: The diagnostic USD root has no SimReady metadata.
what: Supply the required thumbnail and provenance including reconstruction origin, source revision and limitations.
how: Author the selected profile metadata and permitted sidecars with measured-versus-estimated status and a thumbnail of the actual derivative.
completion_evidence: Required metadata rules pass and a consumer can identify exact source, toolchain, profile, rights and uncertainty.
result: Profile metadata, source revision and a new USD-imported thumbnail are authored; material and dimensional provenance are still incomplete.

evidence: The project already separates model, script, font, audio and manufacturer rights.
what: Carry accurate licensing and attribution into the derived package without bundling unlicensed reference media.
how: Inventory every distributed dependency and reconcile its notices with the asset-package and dataset license declarations.
completion_evidence: The complete package has consistent license metadata and retained third-party notices with no implied manufacturer endorsement.
result: Original attribution and applicable font, model and script licenses are carried with the corresponding local files.

evidence: Basic usdchecker success does not establish profile conformance.
what: Run real SimReady static validation against the resolved profile and selected optional features.
how: Use a qualified isolated tool environment to retain per-requirement reports, failing prim paths and exact tier and library versions.
completion_evidence: All mandatory requirements pass and every optional feature claimed by the release is supported by its checks.
result: NVIDIA validator 2026.8.0 reports Robotics-Prop 4.0.0 static PASS; FET_004_STANDARD and FET_004_PHYSX static checks pass, while the report lists unmet optional features including FET_100_ISAAC.

evidence: No Isaac runtime suite was executed in this investigation.
what: Run the supported benchmark suite and actual RTX/PhysX load tests on the derived asset.
how: Execute the installed suite with retained logs, reports and recordings and review drop, settling, contact and material behavior.
completion_evidence: Runtime results contain executed tests with reviewed failures or applicability reasons and no exploding or tunneling assembly.
result: Isaac/RTX/PhysX execution and the NVIDIA benchmark require a supported runtime and graphics environment; local Bullet reconstruction does not replace them.

evidence: A generic joint test can pass when only one joint moves and generic drop tolerances are coarse.
what: Add scale-specific per-joint, placement, support and behavior checks beyond the generic benchmark.
how: Exercise every released motion and representative supported-load and transport scenario using explicit tolerances tied to the intended task.
completion_evidence: Evidence covers each released joint, screen pose, feet and wheel contacts plus any claimed functional behavior.
result: Two-way four-joint Bullet tests, a five-body drop, 49 visual and 49 proxy display samples, an ideal one-axis drive calculation and portable fictional workflow scenarios are recorded; actual transport, PhysX, hold-under-gravity and validated device behavior remain open.

evidence: The public Blender repository is not a SimReady runtime package.
what: Build a complete runtime package with dependency inventory, validation results, benchmark evidence and content hashes.
how: Use the current supported packaging workflow on a derivative-only folder and reopen the exact packaged bytes in a clean location.
completion_evidence: Bill of materials and hashes match all delivered files and forbidden source types are absent from submitted folders.
result: Local layers, original and editable sources, prior inputs, licenses, static reports, assumptions, failure history and hashes are included; no official submission, target-runtime benchmark or manufacturer-verified BOM exists.

evidence: Catalog registration and acceptance are separate from local quality.
what: Prepare a Hugging Face dataset and Central registration only if public catalog contribution is desired.
how: Follow the current collaborator process and submit immutable package-definition URLs with matching licenses and retained release history.
completion_evidence: The intended public revision is reproducible and NVIDIA review outcomes are recorded separately from upload success.
result: No public dataset, catalog registration, upload or submission was requested.

evidence: Consumers need a clear boundary between visualization, synthetic behavior and measured simulation.
what: Deliver the editable source, generated runtime artifact and evidence with precise usage and fidelity documentation.
how: Document supported configurations, dependencies, tests, parameter provenance and known gaps beside the versioned release artifacts.
completion_evidence: A new consumer can open and use the asset without executing Blender scripts or inferring unsupported physical or clinical claims.
result: Original and editable Blender sources, articulated USD, local preview and supporting reports are provided; physical correctness, target runtime and interactive USD behavior remain unverified.
